Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 111. Category: feat. Saiyan Feats.

Requires: S-Cell Awakening
Drawing from the golden light inside always seemed
like a small fraction of its potential, you dig deep inside
you and break through that wall, flooding yourself in
power. You are the legend reborn. You are the Super
Saiyan of Legend.
You gain the Legendary Super Saiyan
Transformation.
